note: 15 candidate topics for the ocean/animal explainer kit, ranked by outlier evidence. Views were read 2026-11-01 from yt-dlp metadata and searches. 'x' = views / that channel's median. All are original angles; do not reuse Depth Theory's scripts. 'Code cost' = how hard the visuals are in our SVG/Remotion kit.

topics.title: Why You'd Never Want To Meet An Orca
evidence: WILD VERSUS 'This Is Why Orcas Are Called Killer Whales' 56M (83x)
OctoLab 'Why The Ocean's Deadliest Predator Refuses To Kill Us' 8.2M (315x, 82K-sub channel)
BeyondTheBlue same title 2.7M (9x)
Fossil 'Would Orcas Dominate Every Prehistoric Ocean?' 3.8M (35x)
OctoLab 'The Way Orcas Prepare for Death' 682K (26x)
topics.risk: Most crowded topic; DT copycat channels already posted 'Why You'd Never Want To Meet An Orca' (43 and 3 views), so the title alone does not carry it. Execution and thumbnail matter.
topics.angle: Hook: the one animal with 'killer' in its name has never killed a person in the wild. Options: you vs a pod that plans. Twist: they teach their young, which is why they leave you alone.

topics.title: What You'd Meet Sinking To The Bottom Of The Ocean (every 1,000 m)
evidence: Mr. Science 'Why Deep Sea Creatures Get Creepier the Deeper You Go' 17M (13.6x)
Spinosnack 'The Deeper You Go, The Creepier Prehistoric Oceans Get' 5.5M (33x)
BeyondTheBlue 'Why Squids get Creepier the Deeper you Go' 2.8M (9.7x)
BRIGHT SIDE 'What Would a Trip to the Mariana Trench Be Like?' 38M
topics.risk: Many 'fall into Mariana Trench' clones with <500 views; needs a 'you' survival angle and a strong depth meter.
topics.code_cost: low (depth gauge + gradient + 8-10 simple creatures; reuses B3 depth meter)
topics.angle: You are sinking; every 1,000 m a new creature and a new way the pressure, cold or dark gets you. A running 'you are still alive' meter.

topics.title: How Long Would You Last In Every Prehistoric Ocean?
topics.format: tournament / era scoreboard with YOU as the contestant
evidence: Fossil 'How Long You'd Last in Every Prehistoric Era' 12M (112x)
BeyondTheBlue 'How Long You'd Last in Every Prehistoric Ocean' 3.3M (11x)
ExtinctZoo 'This Prehistoric Ocean Was Thalassophobia On Steroids' 10M (6.7x)
Depth Theory's own tournament 157K at 26x subs
topics.risk: Long (15-20 min) and creature-heavy (~25 species). Better as a later video once the kit has a creature library.
topics.angle: A stopwatch per era instead of crown/skull; you have a wetsuit and a boat that sinks.
